title: Swiss Government Excellence Scholarship
field: Arts, Engineering, Science, Medicine, Social Sciences, Law
description: The Swiss Government Excellence Scholarship promotes international exchange and research cooperation between Switzerland and over 180 countries. It supports doctoral and postdoctoral researchers at Swiss higher education institutions.
amount: Monthly stipend of CHF 1,920, tuition fee waiver, health insurance, accommodation allowance, return flight allowance
eligibility: International students with a master's degree or equivalent; must be nominated by a Swiss academic supervisor

title: VLIR-UOS Scholarship
field: Agriculture, Health Sciences, Environmental Science, Engineering, Economics, Social Sciences
description: VLIR-UOS provides scholarships to students from developing countries to study at Flemish universities in Belgium. The program aims to strengthen capacities in developing countries through academic training.
amount: Full tuition fee, travel costs, accommodation, living allowance, health insurance, visa application costs
eligibility: Students from 31 eligible developing countries in Africa, Asia, and Latin America

title: New Zealand Development Scholarship
field: Climate Change, Agriculture, Renewable Energy, Public Health, Education, Governance
description: The New Zealand Development Scholarship supports students from developing countries to gain knowledge and skills through postgraduate study in New Zealand. It aims to contribute to sustainable development.
amount: Full tuition fees, fortnightly living allowance, establishment allowance, medical and travel insurance, return airfare, reunion airfare for PhD students
eligibility: Citizens of eligible developing countries in the Pacific, Africa, Asia, Latin America, and the Caribbean
source: New Zealand Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Trade

title: Holland Scholarship
field: Engineering, Business, Arts, Social Sciences, Health, Law
description: The Holland Scholarship is financed by the Dutch Ministry of Education and Dutch research universities and universities of applied sciences. It is meant for international students from outside the European Economic Area who want to pursue a bachelor's or master's degree.
amount: €5,000 one-time grant for the first year of study
university: Various Dutch Research Universities and Universities of Applied Sciences
eligibility: Non-EEA international students applying for a full-time bachelor's or master's program at a participating Dutch institution
source: Dutch Ministry of Education, Culture and Science

title: SIIT Graduate Scholarship
field: Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, Management Technology, Environmental Engineering
description: SIIT provides excellent scholarships for talented international students to pursue graduate studies in engineering, technology, and management at Thammasat University in Thailand.
amount: Full tuition fee waiver, monthly living stipend, research funding, conference travel support, health insurance
eligibility: Bachelor's degree for Master applicants; Master's degree for PhD applicants; strong academic record with minimum CGPA 3.25

title: MPOWER Global Citizen Scholarship
description: The MPOWER Global Citizen Scholarship supports international students who demonstrate a commitment to making a positive social impact. It is open to students at MPOWER's partner institutions in the USA and Canada.
university: MPOWER Partner Universities in USA and Canada
eligibility: International students and DACA recipients enrolled at MPOWER partner institutions in the USA or Canada

title: NTU Research Scholarship
field: Engineering, Science, Business, Humanities, Arts, Social Sciences, Medicine
description: The NTU Research Scholarship is awarded to outstanding graduate students to pursue a full-time PhD program at Nanyang Technological University in Singapore. It supports cutting-edge research across multiple disciplines.
amount: Full tuition fee subsidy, monthly stipend S$2,200-S$2,700, conference allowance, research support grant, annual book allowance
eligibility: Bachelor's degree with Honours (Distinction) or Master's degree; strong academic and research potential; minimum CGPA 3.5

title: MEXT Teacher Training Scholarship
field: Education, Teacher Training, Curriculum Development, Educational Administration
description: The MEXT Teacher Training Scholarship is designed for in-service teachers from overseas to conduct research on school education at Japanese universities. It enhances teaching skills and educational knowledge.
amount: Full tuition fee waiver, monthly stipend of ¥143,000, round-trip economy airfare, accommodation assistance, no enrollment and examination fees
eligibility: Active primary or secondary school teachers with at least 5 years of teaching experience; under 35 years of age
source: Japanese Ministry of Education, Culture, Sports, Science and Technology

title: Stipendium Hungaricum Scholarship
field: Engineering, Medicine, Agriculture, Economics, Social Sciences, Arts, Natural Sciences
description: Stipendium Hungaricum is the Hungarian government's most prestigious higher education scholarship program, offering a wide range of courses for high-achieving international students.
amount: Tuition-free education, monthly stipend HUF 43,700-HUF 140,000, accommodation or contribution to housing costs, medical insurance
eligibility: Citizens of eligible sending partner countries; meet academic requirements of chosen program

title: Lester B. Pearson International Scholarship
field: Arts, Engineering, Science, Business, Architecture, Kinesiology, Music
description: The Lester B. Pearson International Scholarship recognizes outstanding international students who have demonstrated exceptional academic achievement, creativity, and leadership. It covers full undergraduate costs at the University of Toronto.
amount: Full tuition fees for 4 years, incidental fees, book allowance, full residence costs, enrichment and leadership opportunities
eligibility: International secondary school students nominated by their school; demonstrate exceptional academic achievement and creativity

title: Swedish Institute Scholarship for Global Professionals
field: Sustainable Development, Engineering, Information Technology, Public Health, Social Sciences, Design
description: The Swedish Institute Scholarship for Global Professionals (SISGP) aims to develop future global leaders who will contribute to the UN 2030 Agenda for Sustainable Development. It supports full-time master's studies in Sweden.
amount: Full tuition fee waiver, monthly living allowance SEK 12,000, one-time travel grant SEK 15,000, medical and accident insurance
eligibility: Citizens of eligible countries with documented leadership experience and work experience; admitted to a Swedish university master's program

title: Hong Kong PhD Fellowship Scheme
field: Engineering, Science, Social Sciences, Humanities, Business, Medicine
description: The Hong Kong PhD Fellowship Scheme aims to attract the best and brightest students from around the world to pursue their PhD studies in Hong Kong's world-class research universities.
amount: Annual stipend of HK$331,200 (~US$42,500), annual conference and research travel allowance of HK$13,800, tuition fee support
eligibility: Students with outstanding academic performance seeking admission as new full-time PhD candidates in Hong Kong
source: Research Grants Council of Hong Kong

title: Emile Boutmy Scholarship
field: Political Science, Law, Economics, History, Sociology, International Relations
description: The Emile Boutmy Scholarship is awarded by Sciences Po to attract the very best international students from outside the European Union who demonstrate outstanding academic achievement and financial need.
amount: Tuition fee reduction ranging from €3,900 to €14,720 per year depending on program and financial need
eligibility: Non-European international students applying to Sciences Po; based on academic merit and financial need

title: Adelaide Global Academic Excellence Scholarship
field: All Fields offered by the university
description: The University of Adelaide Global Academic Excellence Scholarship rewards high-achieving international students with a significant tuition fee reduction for undergraduate and postgraduate coursework programs.
amount: 50% tuition fee reduction for the duration of the program
eligibility: International students commencing studies at the University of Adelaide; academic excellence (ATAR 98+ or GPA equivalent); minimum CGPA 6.5

title: Danish State Scholarship
field: Engineering, Science, Arts, Social Sciences, Health Sciences, Business
description: Danish universities offer a limited number of government scholarships for highly qualified non-EU/EEA students. The scholarships are administered by individual universities and can cover tuition fees and living costs.
amount: Tuition fee waiver and/or monthly living costs grant up to DKK 6,397/month
eligibility: Non-EU/EEA students with excellent academic records; must be admitted to a participating Danish university
source: Danish Ministry of Higher Education and Science

title: Polish NAWA Ignacy Łukasiewicz Scholarship
field: Engineering, Science, Arts, Humanities, Medicine, Social Sciences
description: NAWA offers the Ignacy Łukasiewicz Scholarship Programme for students from developing countries to pursue master's and PhD studies in Poland, supporting academic excellence and international cooperation.
amount: Monthly stipend PLN 1,500-PLN 2,200, tuition fee waiver at public universities, accommodation support
eligibility: Students from eligible developing countries and Eastern Partnership countries; excellent academic records
source: Polish National Agency for Academic Exchange

title: Rutgers International Chancellor's Scholarship
field: All undergraduate majors offered at Rutgers
description: The Rutgers International Chancellor's Scholarship supports outstanding international undergraduate students with significant tuition support based on academic merit and demonstrated financial need.
amount: Up to full tuition and fees; award amounts vary based on merit and need
eligibility: International students with exceptional academic achievements applying to Rutgers University for undergraduate studies

title: Mexico Government Scholarship for International Students
field: All fields of study available at Mexican institutions
description: The Mexican Agency for International Development Cooperation (AMEXCID) offers scholarships to international students to pursue undergraduate, graduate, and research programs in Mexico.
amount: Monthly stipend MXN 12,000-15,000, tuition fee waiver, medical insurance, visa fee exemption
eligibility: International students from countries with bilateral agreements with Mexico; academic excellence; proficiency in Spanish or English depending on program
source: Mexican Agency for International Development Cooperation (AMEXCID)

title: Romanian Government Scholarship
degree: Bachelor, Master, PhD, Romanian Language Preparatory Year
field: Engineering, Medicine, Architecture, Arts, Sciences, Economics, Agriculture
description: The Romanian Government Scholarship Program provides full support for international students from non-EU countries to study at Romanian universities, including a preparatory year for learning Romanian.
amount: Full tuition fee waiver, monthly stipend, accommodation subsidy, medical insurance, Romanian language preparatory year included
eligibility: Non-EU citizens with good academic results; must submit complete application through Romanian diplomatic missions
